recognize_zh: 拼圖上排是周邊血片：低倍可見白血球極度增多，從骨髓球、後骨髓球到分葉嗜中性球各階段都有，高倍可見一顆顆粒深紫、遮住核的嗜鹼性球，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）慢性期；下排為胸部 X 光的球形擴大心影、病人臉部與心包膜引流管照片，對應 Sanjad-Sakati 症候群與後續心包膜積液。
features: Low-power blood smear (top right): marked leukocytosis with the full spectrum of granulocytic maturation including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, and clusters of cells
High-power blood smear (top left): basophil with coarse dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus, with adjacent myelocytes at the edge
No obvious excess of blasts in the smear fields shown; a platelet aggregate is present
Chest radiograph: enlarged globular cardiac silhouette with overlying lines/leads
Clinical photographs: patient face (eyes masked) and abdomen with a subxiphoid drainage catheter and dressing
describe_en: Composite figure. Peripheral blood smears show marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, with conspicuous myelocytes and metamyelocytes, and a basophil at high power; blasts are not increased in the fields shown. These blood findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase, in keeping with the reported t(9;22) BCR::ABL1 detection. The accompanying chest radiograph shows a globular enlarged cardiac silhouette, and the clinical photographs show the patient and a subxiphoid pericardial drain, correlating with the reported pericardial effusion and tamponade during imatinib therapy.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction shows neutrophilia with toxic granulation and a left shift dominated by bands and metamyelocytes, without absolute basophilia, a myelocyte peak or BCR::ABL1.
Atypical CML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia without significant basophilia and is BCR::ABL1 negative, often with SETBP1 or ASXL1 mutations.
CNL has mature neutrophils with fewer than 10% circulating precursors, no basophilia, and a CSF3R mutation rather than t(9;22).
Blast phase requires ≥20% blasts in blood or marrow or an extramedullary blast proliferation, which is not seen in these smear fields.
